queryContract.sqlPlan: BEGIN READ ONLY → one parameterized SELECT → COMMIT; library ROLLBACK on error; finally parent sql.end({timeout:2}). No type-discovery query, no business writes.
queryContract.errorOutput: Only fixed classification and /^[A-Z0-9]{5}$/ PostgreSQL SQLSTATE or null; no error message/stack/connection string/query/headers/token.
queryContract.timeoutAcceptance: Startup settings and readonly transaction must be honored in actual remote execution; any error is a failed read without fallback or reattempt.

officialSources.facts: Whole Worker remote development uses the configured deployed Hyperdrive; localConnectionString is ignored; remote resources can have real side effects.
Hyperdrive does not support per-binding remote connections from a local Worker; fully remote development is supported.
Legacy remote dev uploads the Worker to a temporary preview environment. It does not isolate the bound production database.
--ip controls the local listening interface. It is not proof of cloud endpoint network isolation.
Eligible read queries can be cached; fresh auth/permission metadata needs caching disabled. Transaction syntax alone is not cited as a freshness guarantee.

steps: Copy only sealed source/bundle/config into a new unique runtime Temp. Preserve hashes; keep this prepared root STOPWRITE.

Root creates random32-byte private gate and private .dev.vars in runtime Temp, never echoing it and excluding the entire secret file from evidence. There are no database credentials or provider source env files.
Confirm active account and fixed binding/cache metadata already reviewed. Do not use localConnectionString or --remote:true on a local binding.

Start exactly one pinned Wrangler 4.127.1 legacy dev child using the argv below in runtime Temp, stdin pipes/no browser/no tunnel/no source watcher edits. Existing authorized CF credentials are supplied solely by the Root controller, not read here.
Await local listener ready via controlled child output/lifecycle and verify explicit 127.0.0.1/port. Do not health-GET the metadata path or retry it while waiting.

Send exactly one GET http://127.0.0.1:18767/registration-metadata with x-registration-probe-token header held in memory. Controller deadline30s; collect only status and strict5-boolean JSON or fixed failure+SQLSTATE. No redirects, query, body, Cookie/Authorization, preview URL/token, or raw Wrangler debug/error dump.

In finally shut the Wrangler child down once, wait/reap it, and verify the listener has closed; separately record real return/signal/forced cleanup. Do not report unknown cleanup as successful. Delete only this runtime Temp secret file after confirming child termination.

Record temporary preview lifetime/cleanup limits honestly. No additional authorize/client registration/resource/link APIs, no normal deploy, no domain/routes, no updates to binding or DB, no automatic retries.

knownLimits: Source/compile proof does not prove runtime socket/binding support, database role ACL, schema/table existence, or source deployment identity.
The temporary worker must bind real production Hyperdrive to answer metadata. Data isolation relies on explicit transaction and fixed SQL, not preview naming.
Public incoming preview network confinement is not guaranteed here; required application token gate is independent of platform preview token.
When default read-only startup settings are unsupported, execution must fail; no permission or connection fallback.
The future Root controller must avoid retaining CLI/debug output that might contain preview or authentication tokens.
No claim that generic CF metadata lifecycle leaves zero trace after dev shutdown.
